provenance.limits: One tenant and one principal. Nothing here is evidence about service-principal behaviour, about sovereign clouds, or about tenants with different licensing or feature flags. Where a route or field is absent, that is not evidence it does not exist -- only that it was not returned under these conditions. Entries may carry their own `provenance` block; where present it overrides this one. A status code is a fact about a principal as much as about a route, so anything resting on one records its principal per entry rather than inheriting it from here. Every entry now carries its own provenance; the block above remains as a default for anything added without one, and verify_evidence.py refuses a manifest lacking it.
